fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2026-03-21, a series of small debits adding up to Rs. 1,20,000 appeared in the statement of the complainant without any authorisation. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2026-03-15 at about 17:25. The online submission was made by Hemanth Murugan (9000000301). The account reference SYN-ACC-100021 was noted in connection with the payment. The complainant alleged that Logesh Karuppasamy may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000198. Pavithra Bai (9000000006) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. A further person, Murugan Sundaram, a friend of the suspect, using the number 9000000207, is stated to be associated with the incident. Items referenced in the complaint: digital documents. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00327, as the mobile number 9000000198 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Multiple small transfers reportedly made in quick succession.
fields.Keywords: bank fraud, unauthorised transaction, witness, main street, digital document, evening, suspect, mobile number
